mapper.select: SELECT id, isbn, title, author, available, created_at FROM books ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, isbn, title, author, available, created_at FROM books WHERE available = TRUE ORDER BY title
SELECT id, isbn, title, author, available, created_at FROM books WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, isbn, title, author, available, created_at FROM books WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
